purpose: Minimal, auditable contract between Benji's controller and Bob's keeper for the single-sided LP buyback on Uniswap V4 (Base). One position, three actions. Active laddering is a deferred separate module — NOT here, to keep v1 small.
venue: Uniswap V4 on Base — singleton PoolManager + v4-periphery PositionManager (ERC-721 position). Pool = PoolKey{currency0, currency1, fee, tickSpacing, hooks}. v1 pins hooks = 0x0000…0000 (NO-HOOK pool) so there is zero hook bytecode in the audit surface. Concentrated-liquidity tick math is identical to V3 — the buyback formula is unchanged.
amounts: All token/USDC quantities are DECIMAL STRINGS in human units (e.g. "5000", "1000000") — 18-dec supplies are not float-safe. Prices (P_top/P_bot/spot) are numbers for display; ticks are authoritative for on-chain math.

target_v1.verify_onchain: pool exists + is RATSPEAK's real price-discovery venue (single-sided buyback only fills against real sell flow); exact tickSpacing for the 1% pool; currency sort order + decimals (USDC 6, RATSPEAK ?).

intent.id: string · idempotency key — keeper dedupes; retries never double-execute
intent.action: "mint" | "burn" | "collect"  (keeper encodes these as v4 PositionManager actions: MINT_POSITION / BURN_POSITION / DECREASE+TAKE for fee collect, inside the unlock callback)

poolkey.currency0: string · lower-sorted token address (address(0) = native ETH)
poolkey.fee: int · e.g. 500 | 3000 | 10000 (LP fee, or dynamic-fee flag)
poolkey.tickSpacing: int · EXPLICIT in v4 (not derived from fee)

intent.P_top: number · upper bound = current spot, USDC/token (mint only)
intent.usdc: decimal string · USDC to deposit (mint only)

fill_report.mode: "LIVE" | "SIMULATED" · controller books LIVE only; SIMULATED is a dry-run for wiring/tests

conventions: PRICE ORIENTATION (critical): ALL prices in intents, fill_reports, and audit blocks are USDC-per-RATSPEAK (human 'USDC/token', e.g. 0.01), regardless of on-chain currency0/1 sort. With USDC as currency0 the raw pool price is RATSPEAK-per-USDC (inverted) and the buyback is a range ABOVE the pool tick — the keeper handles that inversion and reports realized_P_top/P_bot back in USDC-per-token so the controller's geomean/avg-fill math stays correct. Never mix pool-orientation and human-orientation prices.

POOL INIT: a USDC/RATSPEAK 1% V4 pool likely doesn't exist yet → keeper calls PoolManager.initialize(poolKey, sqrtPriceX96) seeded at live market (read on-chain from RATSPEAK's deepest existing pool) before the first mint; a wrong seed price gifts an arb. Consequence: the fresh pool fills the buyback via cross-pool arbitrage from RATSPEAK's main venue, not direct flow — viable but thinner; confirm size makes that worthwhile.
Single-sided mint: deposit USDC only, range entirely below spot in USDC/token terms (P_top = spot). At the bottom it's 100% RATSPEAK = buyback done.
in/out are wallet-perspective: usdc_in spent, token_out received. PnL reconstructed purely from fill_reports with integer/decimal math.

Controller trusts realized_P_bot/P_top from the keeper (v4 sorts currencies + resolves 6-vs-18 decimals on-chain, reports back in USDC/token orientation) — does not recompute price from raw ticks. Realized bounds are WIDER than clean bounds by the tickSpacing snap (200 for the 1% pool) — e.g. 5k USDC recovers ~1.009M RATSPEAK vs a 1.000M clean target, avg 0.004955 vs 0.005. Expected, not a bug.
Controller holds NO keys — keeper owns a dedicated isolated signer. v4 approvals go through Permit2 (keeper-internal). Flash-accounting settle/take handled inside the keeper's unlock callback.
No emissions (Uni V4, no gauge): realized PnL = matched spread + LP fees − gas. No reward line.
No rerange / roll / hooks in v1. If active laddering is added later, it reuses these same three actions in a loop; this contract does not change.
